payload.entry: Verified and fixed the cycler and block-id-prompt phase scope: project recovery strips #prj_is_blocked from every open resident, including residents that stay [?] for their own reasons; Ready recoveries proceed without ledger freshness v12 and warn when it is absent; daily-note and Today skip flags reach markUnblockedLine. Removed the redundant inline project-date checks. Block ID Prompt now reports dependency reasons before schedule reasons and refuses a future-dated ^prj link only when its date is the sole reason; direct Task Links raise Ready ^prj to Next. Updated plugin README rows and manifest versions (task-status-cycler 1.32.0, block-id-prompt 1.28.0), plus docs/task-dependencies.md §5 and §13.4 for the direct-link rule. The recurring-helper audit finding was already covered by bob-ledger-tools freshnessMarkUnblockedLine/freshnessHasRepeatField; no cycler lineIsRecurring helper exists in this checkout. Build passed; focused suites passed 128/128; validate passed 6/6. Full npm test: 2512 passed, with only the allowed tracked failures: four bob-cli-6v unblocked-glyph cases, bob-cli-6w Keep counts once, and bob-cli-3w stage-ranker timing. Deployed both plugins to this host; bob plugins list -n against the opened repo reports 6 synced, 0 drift.
